top_signals.title: Bathla Group Faces Funding Talks as $2.5 Billion Debt Crisis Deepens
top_signals.summary: Bathla Group, the insolvent Australian builder that’s shaken the nation’s real estate and private credit markets, secured stopgap funding to stay afloat for a couple of weeks as it rushes to make headway repaying creditors owed A$3.4 billion ($2.5 billion).
